notes.title: Energysaber Masta VR - 2 new levels and the time control
notes.content:
We added 2 new levels and upgraded the existing one. The improved shield that can be activated without a delay and the new "time control" ability, whenever you feel overwhelmed, activate it to slow everything down and slice that last annoying drone!

More levels are coming, including the leaderboards and achievements. Join our Discord and share your feedback, free keys for early adopters are still there: https://discord.gg/Q4yEbzw

notes.title: LIV SDK lets you play your favorite avatars!
notes.content:
We have integrated LIV SDK which allows you to play your favorite avatar in your favorite energy saber game. You can also mix it with reality to place yourself in the middle of the action. Try it out and show us what you are capable of!

[previewyoutube=v7ANlu3y9Ok;full][/previewyoutube]

Learn how to configure LIV from the [url=https://liv.tv/]LIV official website.[/url]

notes.title: Keep your game progress!
notes.content:
[h2]Resume[/h2]

As the game became longer and harder, we've added an ability to continue your game from the wave you finished. And this game update also includes an ability to keep that wave even between game launches so you can keep slicing these droids!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37912038/1ef2aa320ed4599f4724e49f932969961c17154e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]

We have added quick tips before every wave to describe energysabers capabilities. Let us know if you discover something new!

[h2]Menu[/h2]
To start in a more comfortable environment we introduced the hangar menu, where you can select your level to play, new levels are coming here as well!

[h2]Feedback and free keys[/h2]

Try it out and let us know, what do you think. Please join [url=https://discord.gg/TSDxJB]our Discord server[/url] to share your feedback or get a free Steam key as an early adopter of the Energysaber Masta VR.

notes.title: Bindings for the Valve Index headset
notes.content:
[h2]Supported VR Headsets[/h2]

In the most recent update, we have fixed the bindings for the Valve Index headset and now fully support 4 VR Headsets/Controllers:

- Valve Index
- Oculus Rift
- Oculus Quest
- HTC Vive

Please let us know if we need to adopt more headsets, we will be happy to do so!

[h2]Controls and contronllers[/h2]

As a quick guide, the full list of controls available is below:

1. Index trigger (primary and secondary) - Fire railgun
2. Hand trigger, or Grab (primary and secondary) - Activate force shield
3. Button 1 - Enable saber (optional)
4. Button 2 - Enable second saber side (optional, double-sided)

Is it convenient? Do you want to change something? Let us know, post your comment on the discussion board.

notes.title: Energysaber Masta VR - first game update!
notes.content:
[b]Game update![/b]

The first and not the last update of the game brings you an ability to traverse the spaceship in order to advance in your quest. With every new location, it's harder to protect yourself but with your new railguns and powerful energy lasers, you can do it!

[b]What's new:[/b]

- new lasers
- new drones
- new locations 
- and portals!
